input.caption:
Creamy Garlic Pasta 🍝

This is my go-to weeknight dinner, SAVE IT!

Ingredients:
• 8 oz spaghetti
• 3 cloves garlic, minced
• 1/2 cup parmesan
• 1 cup heavy cream
• salt to taste

Instructions:
1. Boil the pasta until al dente.
2. Sauté garlic in butter for 1 minute.
3. Add cream and parmesan, then toss with pasta.

#pasta #dinner #easyrecipes
